name: tinygres
author: jamesgpearce

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:wasm:paged:built && npm run check:size && npm run check:size:paged
scripts.check:wasm:paged: npm run test:wasm:paged && npm run check:size:paged
scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm run test:browser && npm run test:package
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:ts
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run typecheck:browser && playwright test
scripts.test:wasm:paged: npm run build:wasm:paged && npm run test:wasm:paged:built
scripts.test:wasm:paged:built: vitest run test/worker/wasm-wire.test.ts test/worker/wasm-wire-cross.test.ts && playwright test test/browser/paged-memory.spec.ts

description: A tiny, worker-first relational database for browser apps.
